description: This file defines the Country model class within the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It provides methods to retrieve country data from the database, including fetching by country ID, ISO codes, and retrieving all countries.

classes.name: Country
classes.description: A model class for managing country data within the localisation context of the OpenCart platform, providing methods to retrieve country information from the database.

methods.name: getCountry
methods.description: Retrieves a country record by its primary key ID, returning an array with country details.

methods.name: getCountryByIsoCode2
methods.description: Retrieves a country record using the ISO 2-code, returning an array with country details.

methods.name: getCountryByIsoCode3
methods.description: Retrieves a country record using the ISO 3-code, returning an array with country details.

methods.name: getCountries
methods.description: Retrieves all active countries with descriptions in the current language, utilizing caching for efficiency.
